method: Read and independently executed author algebraic replay, output redirected only; no numerical RHS/time integration. All101 raw states exactly reconstructed from stored stage fluxes and remap; Y0/Y1/Y2/final accepted NASA recovery and original independent reference recomputed. Additionally independently recomputed all norms from physical candidate/reference arrays.
limits: One prescribed NASA pair/pressure-ratio and two levels, not all nine shocks or original full mesh/CFL sequence.
Orders of uncertainty-inclusive errors are descriptive two-level observations, not full asymptotic qualification.
No production capability, whole method/BCR or S06 acceptance.
